entries.text: AC-1..AC-4 done and verified. Both named functions (_repository_text_candidates and test_production_python_has_no_legacy_config_auth_consumers) now derive their candidate set from `git ls-files` via a new shared _tracked_repository_files() helper, per backlog's preferred direction -- no exclusion-list fallback was needed, since .venv/venv/.tox/site-packages/build/dist (all .gitignore'd) structurally cannot appear in git-tracked output, for this or any future tool directory. New fixture test (test_candidate_scanners_catch_tracked_matches_and_ignore_venv_content) stages a real tracked-content match via git add and a synthetic .venv-style untracked file with identical colliding text, proving both functions still catch the former and ignore the latter. Targeted tests: 6 passed. Full one-shot regression (.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -n auto --dist worksteal, foreground, awaited to actual completion): 3093 passed, 25 skipped, 2 failed. AC-5 done: backlog.json's dlp_scanner_venv_exclusion marked done with full resolution note. STOP per AC-6: the 2 full-regression failures are NOT the .venv-walk symptom this item targeted -- this worktree has no project-local .venv at all, and the fixture test independently proves the .venv blind spot is closed. They are project/build_history.json:47 and relay/NXS-LOCAL-0003-local-relay-watch-command.json:155, both containing literal collision substrings inside prose describing this exact defect -- i.e. the historical record of the bug trips the bug's own detector, independent of any .venv. This was previously conflated with real .venv/site-packages noise and never isolated. RELAY_DECISION NXS-LOCAL-0012 already ruled these same 2 findings pre-existing/accepted, build-history-immutable, not to be edited -- but scoped that explicitly as 'a one-time exception for this specific push', not a standing waiver. Filed as new backlog item dlp_scanner_prose_collision_in_frozen_records (out of this movement's declared scope: candidate-selection logic only, not the frozen records).
